name: Algolia AI Search
tagline: Algolia AI Search is an API-first search and retrieval platform combining semantic and keyword search, vector embeddings, relevance tuning, personalization, and ranking controls. Teams use it to build fast search, conversational discovery, and agent-driven experiences on their own content and product data.
